q1.text: Some columns hold dates (`visit`). Should the map ignore them, or use only whether each date is filled in?

options.label: Ignore dates
options.effect: Leaves date columns out of the map

options.label: Use whether date is filled in
options.effect: Leaves raw dates out of the map (1 date column has no blanks and stays out)

q2.text: 2 columns (`dose` and `dose_txt`) only have values when `flag` is not 0 — they are blank for everyone else. Should the map use them?

options.label: Leave out
options.effect: Leaves `dose` and `dose_txt` out of the map because the blank pattern largely repeats `flag`

options.label: Treat blanks as 0
options.effect: Keeps in the map with blanks set to 0 and no blank marker (largely repeats `flag`)

options.label: Fill with median and mark blanks
options.effect: Keeps in the map with blanks filled by the median and adds a 0/1 blank marker that largely repeats `flag`

q3.text: 2 columns mostly hold numbers but also the value 'unk' (8 entries in total; e.g. `code_mixed`: 6). Should those values count as their own category, or as unreadable entries treated like blanks?

options.label: Treat as categories
options.effect: Each distinct value (including non-numeric text) gets its own 0/1 category column; blanks become '(blank)'

options.label: Treat non-numeric text as blank
options.effect: 8 'unk' entries become blanks and are estimated with the median of observed numbers, plus a 0/1 blank marker

options.label: Leave out
options.effect: Leaves `code_mixed` and `amount_mixed` out of the map

q4.text: `age` and `weight` never record a 0. Both are blank for the same 4 rows. Does a blank mean none (zero), or that the value is unknown?

options.label: Blank means zero (none)
options.effect: Both columns get 0 where blank; no extra marker column

options.label: Blank means unknown
options.effect: Blanks are filled with the median of observed rows, plus one shared 0/1 marker column for the blank pattern

q5.text: `count` is blank for 3 rows and never records a 0. Does a blank mean none (zero), or that the value is unknown?

options.label: Blank means zero (none)
options.effect: Blanks become 0; no extra marker column

options.label: Blank means unknown
options.effect: Blanks are filled with the median of observed rows, plus a 0/1 marker column for which rows were blank

q6.text: Is any column a result you want to explain after the map is drawn (for example a diagnosis, outcome, or survival status)? Columns used to draw the map cannot fairly be used to explain it afterwards.

options.label: None of them
options.effect: Keeps all current columns as map inputs

age.reason: 4 blanks; no recorded 0; blank on the same rows as 1 other column (mg2)

weight.reason: 4 blanks; no recorded 0; blank on the same rows as 1 other column (mg2)

dose.reason: 14 blanks; blank on the exact rows where flag is 0

dose_txt.reason: 14 blanks; blank on the exact rows where flag is 0

code_mixed.reason: mostly numbers with 'unk' (6 rows; 1 blank); kept as 4 categories

amount_mixed.reason: mostly numbers with 'unk' (2 rows; 1 blank); non-numeric text treated as blank with median fill and blank marker

city.reason: text column with 3 categories and 2 blanks; blanks become '(blank)' category

city_full.reason: 20 distinct text categories (exceeds sqrt(40) = 6); would add 20 columns

const.reason: one distinct value; adds no distance information
